articles.t: Zelda Ocarina of Time Switch 2 Release Date vs GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Zelda Ocarina of Time hits Switch 2 Nov. 5, just 14 days before GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox. Here is why the overlap may not matter.
articles.txt:
Nintendo and Rockstar Games are about to run one of the strangest release-calendar experiments in modern gaming. On November 5, 2026, Nintendo puts out The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2. Fourteen days later, on November 19, 2026, Rockstar ships Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Gaming outlets including The Game Business, Nintendo Everything, Nintendo Life, Nintendo Wire, and Notebookcheck have spent the past several weeks asking the same question: why would Nintendo plant its biggest nostalgia bet of the decade directly in the blast radius of the most anticipated game of the generation?
The short answer, according to the bulk of current reporting, is that it might not be a blast radius at all. The two games sit on different hardware, chase different household budgets at different moments, and arrive with different kinds of risk attached. Here is what is actually confirmed about the two launches, what is still speculation dressed up as analysis, and why the zelda ocarina of time switch 2 release date landing so close to GTA VI has become the most-discussed scheduling decision of the holiday season.

Grand Theft Auto VI has carried a firm, Rockstar-confirmed release date of November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S for months, a timeline Digital Trends has tracked since the game’s earliest reveals . It is, by almost every measure, the single biggest release window in gaming this year. Publishers have spent 2026 quietly shuffling their own calendars away from that date, clearing a runway for Rockstar the way retailers clear space around a holiday blockbuster film.
Nintendo did the opposite. During a Direct presentation tied to the 40th anniversary of the Zelda franchise, the company revealed that its remake of the 1998 classic would launch November 5, 2026, a date widely reported by outlets including NME . That places the Ocarina of Time remake just 14 days ahead of GTA VI, inside the same holiday shopping window and squarely inside the same news cycle that Rockstar’s launch will otherwise dominate.
That gap is small enough to matter and large enough to be deliberate. Two weeks is roughly the amount of time a committed player needs to finish a remake of a game built for a 10-to-15-hour original campaign, padded out with new content, before a second 80-hour-plus open world absorbs their attention span entirely. It is also roughly the window retailers need to run a full cycle of launch-week promotion before a bigger story pushes it off the front page.
Strip away the speculation and the confirmed facts about GTA VI are narrow but solid. According to IGN’s tracking page for the game , Rockstar has set November 19, 2026, as the release date, and the game is confirmed only for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC version has been announced. No Nintendo Switch 2 version has been announced either, despite months of fan speculation and at least one round of reporting in which Nintendo addressed the possibility of a Switch 2 port without committing to one.
That platform gap is the single most important fact in this entire story. A Switch 2 owner who does not also own a PlayStation 5 or an Xbox Series X|S has no way to play GTA VI on launch day, full stop. There is no cross-shopping decision to make between the two games for that customer, because only one of them is available to them at all.
Rockstar has not issued public commentary explaining why November 19 was chosen over an earlier or later date, and no statement from the studio addresses the Zelda remake’s proximity. Readers should treat any claim about Rockstar’s internal reasoning as outlet speculation rather than confirmed company position, because that is exactly what it is right now.
Nintendo’s remake of Ocarina of Time is reported as a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive launching November 5, 2026. That date has been echoed across multiple gaming outlets since the anniversary Direct, and it is the figure this entire comparison hinges on. What is not nailed down, at least not in a form traceable to an on-record Nintendo statement, is the company’s internal reasoning for picking a date two weeks ahead of the biggest release of the console generation.

articles.t: GTA 6 November 'rival' drops 9/10 free sample on Steam for a limited-time
articles.chapeau: It's not sticking around for too long 🦖🔥
articles.txt:
Enjoy a free Steam demo for one of the few games willing to go head-to-head with GTA 6.
The fiercest rival of GTA VI has just dropped a 9/10 rated free demo on Steam. Unfortunately, no, it’s not The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but it is something a lot more godly.
After years of agonising waiting, GTA VI finally arrives next month, bringing all-new mayhem to Rockstar Games' modern-day Vice City.
However, this November, we’re not only being treated to GTA VI and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but also the remaster of all remasters. We’re, of course, talking about Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered , and right now, you can play its free demo on Steam.
This playable demo is only available on PC via Steam, despite the game coming to PlayStation, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2. What’s more, it's also is only available on Steam until 27 October 2026.
Never fear, though, because the full game is out very soon, on 3 November 2026, across all available platforms, so at least we won’t have to wait very long to enjoy the full breadth of Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered .
Originally released for Nintendo GameCube in October 2002 before arriving on Xbox the following year, Pipeworks Studio’s Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee quickly became a cult classic and is still viewed favourably all these years later. Hence why it’s getting a remaster after 24 years.
Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee is a fighting game that lets you control iconic kaiju, including Godzilla, Mothra and King Ghidorah, as they battle across destructible cities, causing all sorts of chaos as they go.
This release features enhanced visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, with improved lighting, weather and destruction effects. Each kaiju has an additional campaign, and the game also features online multiplayer and much more.
It's one of very few games actually willing to brave November and launch ahead of GTA VI , which has generated plenty of memes and jokes online, plus earned the general respect of the industry.
"The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer," reads the synopsis of the game.

articles.t: GTA 6 Features "Significantly Narrower" Roads Than GTA 5; Devs Wanted Weapons System to Be More Like Red Dead Redemption 2
articles.chapeau: Rockstar confirms GTA 6 features "significantly narrower" roads than GTA 5, as they experimented on the game's weapon system for years.
articles.txt:
Vehicle chases are often a big part of any Grand Theft Auto game, and if you find it easy to drive around pedestrians and other vehicles in GTA 5, that will prove to be harder in GTA 6.
If you’re expecting Grand Theft Auto 6 to be bigger in every way compared to GTA 5, there’s at least one thing that’s now known, and that’s smaller: the roads.
This new tidbit of info might be something people noticed in the trailers, but it’s now confirmed.
In a video talking about his experience visiting Rockstar’s main studio in Scotland, Jason Schreier talked about some of the info he wasn’t able to put in his “Making Of” GTA 6 feature .
According to Art Director Aaron Garbut. the roads are “significantly narrower” in GTA 6 than they were in GTA 5.
This was something Schreier didn’t notice until the developers pointed it out. In GTA 5, which was set in a fictional representation of Los Angeles, players saw these really wide roads that made it easy to zip through the streets and bypass traffic, and speed past other cars. Players really didn’t feel any traffic of any kind, which is an unrealistic depiction of LA. This made the game feel more racing game-ish, as players were freely driving around the city.
That won’t be the case with GTA 6. Rockstar’s idea for this highly anticipated sequel is narrower roads and denser traffic, which are things the studio has decided on from the very beginning of development.
This design decision had ripple effects to the rest of development. as Garbut said, “All these things sort of come to bite you later,” since this meant denser roads, narrower roads that equated to a lot more buildings, more construction around that concept — which is what Rockstar did.
Another thing mentioned in the video is how realistic GTA 6 would be, and how much of these big systems from Red Dead Redemption 2 are going to carry over to this GTA game.
Rob Nelson, also one of the development leads, mentioned that Rockstar knew they wanted GTA 6’s weapon system to be more like Red Dead 2, where players couldn’t just carry an unlimited number of guns. Rockstar wanted it to be more realistic, where players had to select a loadout; players had to have a limited number of weapons they can hold at any given time.
Rockstar didn’t want it where players could just pull a rocket launcher out, then their guns and other stuff too. The developers’ idea was to use a weapon wheel but their concern was, wouldn’t all these blank spaces remind people of what they can’t actually do? What they can’t carry, and so on.
Rockstar second-guessed whether they should use a weapon wheel, and spent months — if not years — trying different things that would replace the weapon wheel. The devs tried trays, webs, and all sorts of different variations in the UI to just replace the weapon wheel. They even tried not having one, and after trying all these different iterations, they wound back where they started: with a weapon wheel, which is what players will see in the final version of GTA 6.
I’m interested in how these narrower roads will work in the game. It will probably make chases much more exciting and action-packed, and not to mention, way harder.
In related GTA 6 news, the developers revealed that players can expect “hundreds” of interior spaces that can be explored .

articles.t: 'There's No One Person That Has This Whole Thing in Their Head' — GTA 6 Devs Had Freedom to Add Cool Features Just Like RDR2's Horse Balls
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games gave the GTA 6 developers so much freedom to add cool details that not even the studio's top executives are aware of everything in the game.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games gave GTA 6 s' developers so much freedom to add cool details that not even the studio's top executives are aware of everything in the game.
The latest behind-the-scenes information on GTA 6 comes from Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, who expanded upon his trip to the Rockstar North offices in Edinburgh, Scotland, after previously sharing other highlights last week . One of the more noteworthy bits shared in his 18-minute video's runtime is that the team who spent a decade or so making next month's Grand Theft Auto game had quite a bit of freedom to add details simply because they thought they might be cool.
Schreier said he'd guess that "not even top developers" at Rockstar know every tiny detail added to Vice City and its wealth of NPCs. He noted that giving large teams the autonomy to flesh out every street corner isn't too uncommon for open-world games. In the case of GTA 6 and its huge budget and lengthy development time, that means players will likely still be discovering new details even years down the road.
Schreier shared a quote from Rockstar's Aaron Garbut, who said, "There's no one person that has this whole thing in their head." That's probably not too new for the GTA team, with the video also recalling one specific detail from Red Dead Redemption 2 .
Players may remember that horses found through the cowboy simulator had testicles with realistic physics. The thing fans still love to pass around to this day is the fact that they even shrink in colder weather.
Garbut mentioned that this specific feature (if you can call it that) was not something Rockstar had on some big list of details to include in Red Dead Redemption 2, nor was it something the team was ever asked to spend extra time on. Instead, the shrinking horse testicles, like many other details in the 2018 Western sandbox game, was something that someone happened to have enough time to work on and bring to life. It's this same strategy that fans can expect to see implemented in GTA 6.
Schreier's video also revealed that Rockstar spent quite a bit of time trying to do away with the weapon wheel it had leaned on in past games. Worried that slapping a game-y wheel on Jason and Lucia would remind players of what they can't carry on their person, they attempted to create a new system to replace it. The team then spent "months, if not years, trying a million different things." Examples listed include trays, webs, and UI updates for the formula before eventually, as we've seen , tossing all of those ideas out the window and going back to the traditional weapon wheel.
Meanwhile, as one might imagine could be the case over the course of developing a major video game, Rockstar's long path to launch wasn't without its roadblocks. Schreier said the "dark moments" of development saw the GTA 6 team struggle between the years of about 2019 to 2022. He said Rockstar's desire to balance the realism of Red Dead Redemption gameplay with the traditionally more arcade-y systems GTA is known for was the driving factor.
It was during this time that some team members felt they were just "treading water," leading the project to shed some designers before the vision really started coming together toward the beginning of 2023. According to Schreier's reporting, some Rockstar artists have been working on GTA 6 since 2015, just two years after the launch of GTA 5. It was this same year the team started taking trips to Miami to plot out their reimagined Vice City.
Now, after all this time, GTA 6 is exactly one month away (!) from its November 19, 2026, release date. To help hype up everyone who has waited 13 years to see if it was worth the long, long wait, Rockstar has taken over Miami. One recent example from its marketing push includes a collection of cars ripped straight out of the game .
For more, you can check out new details and screenshots from the GTA 6 launch trailer . Rockstar has insisted it won't take another eight years to make its next game , but as we wait during these last 30 days for this one, you can read IGN's interview with Rob Nelson .

articles.t: Report indicates 'GTA 6' launching on PC in early 2027
articles.chapeau: That's sooner than expected.
articles.txt:
Lots of people are excited about Grand Theft Auto VI , but PC players haven't been sure when they will be able to play it . That might have just changed.
Citing four different industry sources, GamesBeat reported that Rockstar plans to launch GTA 6 on PC in the first quarter of 2027, or by the end of March, in other words. That would certainly be a pivot from the company's previous PC strategy, as GTA 5 came out on PC nearly two years after its console launch, while Red Dead Redemption 2 took a little more than a year to escape consoles.
This is big for a few reasons. First and foremost, if the report is accurate, people who primarily game on PC won't have to wait as long to play GTA 6 as they thought they might have to. It also means anyone who wants the most premium experience possible with the game might not have to agonize over whether or not to buy a PS5 Pro , as PC could offer the best version of the game — if you have a strong enough machine, anyway.
Beyond that, if Rockstar ends up doing an online mode for GTA 6 , the PC version could be the home of the popular and growing GTA roleplaying community, as it has been for GTA 5 . The PC ecosystem allows for much more freedom in terms of supporting user-created content, making it ideal for roleplayers.

articles.chapeau: Expect a lot of unhinged detailing in GTA 6 similar to Red Dead Redemption 2
articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter GTA 6 was made by an army of thousands of game developers who had to be coordinated by Rockstar Games , but some of the studio's best work is the result of individuals using the independence afforded to them to enact the kind of chaotic goodness that would make a tabletop dungeon master smirk. Case in point: horse scrotums in Red Dead Redemption 2.
The buried details of GTA 6's mammoth production line are examined in a new video from Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, who paused to share some information from a recent Rockstar visit that couldn't fit into a prior written report.
Rockstar North art director Aaron Garbut looks at the scope and granularity that Rockstar has to balance. "There's no one person that has this whole thing in their head," he says.
Schreier, seemingly sharing his own thoughts and no longer quoting Garbut, adds, "Grand Theft Auto 6 is a humongous game, like Rockstar's previous games, and I imagine that not even the top developers of this company know every single thing that's in the game."
This is important context because it directly connects to something that Garbut singles out: the kind of unhinged perfectionism and attention to detail that gets you video game horses with testicles that convincingly shrink based on the temperature.
Herein lies the thin but magical boundary between disorganized development and meaningful autonomy. It's not that the studio heads, discipline leads, direct reports, and overarching producers at Rockstar don't know what's in GTA 6, or that designers are regularly going rogue with no oversight. All of those roles exist precisely because no one person can know and be accountable for everything in this game. But under that structured network, there's still space for designers, artists, and others to have agency and make individual contributions in their corner.
"Garbut actually brought this up," Schreier says of the famous Red Dead 2 horses. "That was not something that was on some big list of features to make. It was not something that an art director told an artist. 'All right, we got to get those horse testicles in here. Better put in nights and weekends so you can get these horse testicles in here.' That was something that people or a person, on their own, autonomously, decided, 'I'm going to do this because I think it's a really cool detail and I have enough time to work on it.'"
Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more
Games like GTA 6 are partly the result of a lot of little things done well many times over within, and in service of, broader creative frameworks. Allowing space for surprises to manifest is how a lot of the magic happens in some of the most beloved games of all time, and this highlights one way that mismanaged or unhealthy development cycles actively hurt games (on top of, more importantly, people).
Great ideas that might've been found or implemented may never happen because people don't have the space, or the headspace, for them. If simply getting a game shipped is a buzzer-beating nightmare, refining and indulging in it gets that much harder. (Red Dead Redemption 2's development was notoriously filled with crunch periods , though some employees publicly pushed back on crunch accusations in 2018.)
We're still talking about the horses in Red Dead Redemption 2 because they reflect that game's extreme commitment to authenticity, zoology, and wonderfully unnecessary content. If those horse testicles were less realistic, nobody would care. But, demonstrably, the work of whoever is tragically not listed as Testicle Designer in the game's credits did improve the game and people's perception of it. Because after you find one of those little surprises, you start to look for more details, more fingerprints from individual developers making their mark despite being one of hundreds or thousands. The AAA games that actually justify their excess are full of stuff like this, and it sounds like GTA 6 will be too.

If you've ever played a Rockstar game and wondered how on earth someone thought to include such a ridiculously specific detail, here's your answer: sometimes, it's because a developer simply thought it would be cool – and even their colleagues have no idea they put it there!
From the way flip-flops actually bend and slap against a character's heel as they walk in GTA 5 to horse testicles reacting to the cold in Red Dead Redemption 2 , the studio’s attention to detail has become one of its biggest trademarks. Now, an interesting behind-the-scenes detail about how this approach works has been revealed.
In a video shared on his personal YouTube channel, journalist Jason Schreier discussed the scale of GTA 6, revealing that Aaron Garbut , co-studio head of Rockstar North and a longtime art director who has worked on every major 3D and HD entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, explained that no single person has the entire game mapped out in their head.
“There’s no one person who has this whole thing in their head,” Garbut said. “Grand Theft Auto 6 is a humongous game, like Rockstar’s previous games, and I imagine that not even the top developers of this company know every single thing that's in the game.”
Yes, you're not alone if you find that pretty wild to hear for the first time. However, Schreier went into the reasons behind this after visiting Rockstar in person to check out how GTA 6 is being built – and it actually makes quite a bit of sense! Basically, according to the journalist, Rockstar seems to give individual developers some autonomy to introduce details, features, and other elements they personally find interesting. So, unlike other triple-A open-world projects where every little detail is meticulously planned out, employees can sometimes take the initiative and bring their own ideas to life.
Schreier himself used the horse testicles in Red Dead Redemption 2 as an example. This wasn't some grand feature conceived during a meeting between Rockstar's executives, but rather the kind of detail that an individual developer decided to implement because they thought it would be cool and had enough time to work on it. It's a pretty amusing example, but it also offers a glimpse into Rockstar's creative process: when developers have room to experiment, even the tiniest ideas can become part of a much larger game. And that approach could make GTA 6 particularly interesting to explore!

articles.t: Un fan recrée le trailer de GTA 6 dans GTA 5 et la différence est impressionnante - Dexerto
articles.chapeau: Un joueur recrée le trailer de GTA 6 dans GTA 5 et révèle une différence graphique spectaculaire entre les deux jeux de Rockstar.
articles.txt:
GTA Un fan recrée le trailer de GTA 6 dans GTA 5 et la différence est impressionnante par Ludovic Quinson Publié : 19 oct. 2026, 13:06 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News Plus de treize ans séparent GTA 5 de GTA 6 , et une nouvelle vidéo permet de mesurer à quel point la technologie de Rockstar a évolué. Un joueur s’est amusé à reproduire la dernière bande-annonce de GTA 6 dans son prédécesseur, avec un résultat qui a rapidement fait réagir les fans.
Alors que Rockstar vient de dévoiler le trailer de lancement de GTA 6 , les fans continuent d’en analyser les moindres détails. Mais plutôt que de chercher des indices sur le scénario, un créateur a choisi de comparer directement les deux générations de Grand Theft Auto.
Le créateur GearOS Plays a entrepris de reproduire les plans de la nouvelle bande-annonce en utilisant GTA 5. Pour cela, il a recherché des décors similaires à Los Santos et tenté de retrouver les mêmes cadrages que dans les séquences officielles de GTA 6. Le résultat met particulièrement en évidence les progrès réalisés sur les éclairages, les textures, les animations et la densité des environnements.
Si GTA 5 reste visuellement solide malgré son âge, la comparaison souligne le fossé technique entre les deux productions, notamment dans le rendu des personnages et l’ambiance générale des scènes.
La vidéo a rapidement circulé sur les réseaux sociaux, où de nombreux joueurs se sont montrés impressionnés. “ Quand on compare GTA 5 et GTA 6, le premier ressemble à Minecraft “, plaisante un internaute. Un autre affirme qu’il lui sera désormais difficile de regarder GTA 5 de la même manière.
Ce n’est pas la première fois que les différences graphiques entre les deux jeux font débat. Ned Luke, l’acteur qui incarne Michael dans GTA 5, avait lui aussi souligné l’évolution spectaculaire de la technologie de Rockstar. Selon lui, les progrès accomplis depuis le précédent épisode rendent toute comparaison particulièrement difficile.

Cette recréation permet surtout de prendre conscience du chemin parcouru par Rockstar et contribue à faire monter l’impatience autour de son prochain monde ouvert.

articles.t: Cyberleek says 'GTA 6' leaks are over, warns of dead man's switch
articles.chapeau: Sounds like we're done with all of this.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek might finally, mercifully, be done sharing Grand Theft Auto VI clips.
On the Cyberleek website, as spotted by Reddit and cited by Kotaku , the person or group of people behind all the recent GTA 6 leaks you may have seen on your social feeds appeared to call it quits. According to the post, the leaker's threat to release a full build of the game will seemingly go unfulfilled, as they did not meet the $30 million market value goal for their memecoin. However, the post did imply that there is a "dead man's switch" in place that will release the build, or some other kind of spoiler content, if anyone tries to "remove" Cyberleek.
"CL has the ending. It was considered. It would punish Take-Two greatly - but ruin the experience for the gamers, who did nothing wrong," the post said. "Take-Two would show CL no mercy - why should CL show any to them? Still: Take-Two was punished enough. The ending stays unpublished. Proof: the latest leek - clips from the final missions, out of context, revealing nothing. The dead man's switch is active - story spoilers only. Left alone, it never fires. Whoever removes CL chooses it."
Rockstar and Take-Two Interactive, the makers of GTA 6, have already subpoenaed Google, Microsoft, X, and Discord in their efforts to unmask and stop Cyberleek.
The leaker's post went on to defend the meme-coin at the center of the leaks, claiming it was not a "rugpull."
“CL was transparent about the token from day one: a donation, never an investment," Cyberleek said. "It changed nothing – influencers decided the story before the facts arrived. The Edict stands. The leeks stop here. For now.”
Over the past few months, the anonymous leaker has posted roughly 20 or so out-of-context clips that mostly showed the game's protagonists driving around and/or beating up NPCs, although the leaker did start sharing some story spoilers . By the end, they were showing both protagonists rendered completely nude, but it's arguable that none of the leaks told us as much about the game as Rockstar's own Netflix trailer did in August.
Regardless, it seems like this Cyberleek saga is over for the time being. It's only about a month until the game launches on Nov. 19, and gamers can preorder the game ahead of its release.

A poll has shown a surprising number of people suggesting that they would not be OK if their partner became too invested in the Lucia and Jason romance in GTA 6.

Players control both Lucia and Jason, and can choose to have them actively participate in a romantic relationship. In the poll, roughly 6% responded that they would see it as cheating. 19% stated they would “not be okay” if their partners became too heavily invested in the digital romance.
GTA 6 releases on November 19th, with excitement hitting a fever pitch. It’s a generational release, starting to amass buzz like few others can. Players will be able to choose if they want Jason and Lucia to be romantically involved. That includes holding hands, kissing at a button prompt, taking showers together and more.
The game’s pre-load will begin on November 12th, one week before it launches on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 consoles. Per a recent report , the game’s PC launch may not be too far off. If you only own an Xbox One console you may be in luck if streaming via Xbox’s cloud service is an option.

articles.t: Red Dead Redemption 3 : une sortie dès 2028 ? La banque Citi relance les rumeurs sur le prochain Rockstar
articles.chapeau: Red Dead Redemption 3 pourrait sortir en 2028 selon Citi. Découvrez les dernières rumeurs sur sa sortie, son histoire et ses futurs personnages.
articles.txt:
Red Dead Redemption 3 pourrait bien arriver plus tôt que prévu, avec une sortie potentielle en 2027 ou 2028. C'est du moins l'hypothèse avancée par la banque d'investissement américaine Citi , qui s'est penchée sur les finances de Take-Two Interactive et le coût de développement de GTA 6 . Une analyse qui remet sur la table le retour de la célèbre franchise western de Rockstar Games , huit ans après la sortie de Red Dead Redemption 2 . Mais entre projections financières et véritables informations sur le jeu, il y a encore quelques kilomètres de désert à traverser à cheval...
L'information remonte au 15 octobre 2026 . Dans une note destinée aux investisseurs, Citi estime qu' un nouveau Red Dead pourrait débarquer en 2027 ou 2028 , une perspective jugée « pas déraisonnable » par les analystes de la banque américaine.
L'analyse repose sur un élément financier intéressant: le budget colossal de GTA 6 ne serait finalement pas aussi astronomique que certaines estimations le laissaient entendre...
Dans une interview accordée à Bloomberg le 14 octobre, Jennifer Kolbe , responsable de l'édition chez Rockstar Games, a effectivement démenti les estimations plaçant le développement de GTA 6 au-delà de 1,5 milliard de dollars , sans pour autant communiquer son véritable budget.
Or, Citi relève que Take-Two comptabilise environ 2,4 milliards de dollars de coûts de développement de logiciels activés . Une différence théorique d'environ 900 millions de dollars qui pourrait, selon la banque, suggérer l'existence d'un autre projet particulièrement ambitieux dans les cartons de l'éditeur. Et difficile de ne pas penser à Red Dead Redemption.
Red Dead Redemption - Rockstar Games & Take-Two Attention toutefois: ces 900 millions ne représentent pas un budget officiellement réservé à Red Dead Redemption 3 . Les chiffres concernent les activités de Take-Two dans leur ensemble, et non exclusivement Rockstar. Citi formule donc une hypothèse financière, pas une révélation sur un jeu tenu secret.
Reste que cette perspective a de quoi rassurer les investisseurs: un nouveau Red Dead permettrait à Take-Two d'enchaîner deux énormes sorties après GTA 6 , actuellement attendu le 19 novembre 2026, et d'éviter une trop forte baisse de revenus après le lancement de son mastodonte.
Il faut effectivement rappeler un détail qui a son importance: Rockstar Games n'a toujours pas annoncé officiellement Red Dead Redemption 3 . Aucun teaser , aucune fenêtre de sortie, aucune plateforme et encore moins de présentation du gameplay.
Le calendrier imaginé par Citi apparaît d'ailleurs très optimiste . Red Dead Redemption est sorti en 2010, GTA 5 en 2013, Red Dead Redemption 2 en 2018, et GTA 6 doit arriver en 2026. Les productions majeures de Rockstar sont désormais espacées de plusieurs années, avec des développements toujours plus complexes.
Lucia Caminos et Jason Duval, les protagonistes de GTA VI Imaginer un nouveau western seulement un ou deux ans après GTA 6 supposerait donc que son développement ait déjà considérablement avancé en parallèle. Ce qui reste parfaitement possible, mais absolument pas démontré.
L'avenir de la licence paraît néanmoins moins incertain que sa date de sortie. Dès 2021, Strauss Zelnick , PDG de Take-Two , expliquait que des franchises comme GTA et Red Dead pouvaient perdurer très longtemps, à condition de maintenir leur qualité. Le retour de Red Dead paraît commercialement logique. Reste à savoir si Rockstar dispose réellement d'un troisième épisode suffisamment avancé pour viser 2028.
Si le développement d'un troisième épisode venait à se confirmer, Rockstar aurait plusieurs possibilités pour poursuivre sa franchise . La plus populaire parmi les spéculations des joueurs reste celle d'un nouveau préquel, situé avant les événements de Red Dead Redemption 2.
Pour rappel, Red Dead Redemption 2 se déroule principalement en 1899 , à une époque où les hors-la-loi sont progressivement chassés par les autorités. articles.t: GameStop’s used PS5 Pro prices are raising eyebrows as GTA 6 approaches
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto VI's exclusivity is driving heightened demand for the high-end PlayStation 5 Pro console, and it's not looking great.
articles.txt:
PlayStation 5 buyers are facing another difficult period, with rising console prices and reports of dwindling PS5 Pro stock just weeks before Grand Theft Auto VI arrives. According to a report from gaming outlet PlayFront , Sony has warned retailers that shortages of its premium console could persist into early 2027, potentially leaving players with limited options as demand increases.
The report cites a retailer memo describing “temporary market supply constraints and high demand,” with the shortage expected to continue “through early 2027 at the earliest.” Major retailers, including Sony's own online store, have reportedly run out of stock. The upcoming launch of GTA 6 on November 19 is considered a potential factor, as some players may want to upgrade to Sony's most powerful console ahead of Rockstar's highly anticipated release .
The supply crunch is also affecting the secondhand market. GameStop has reportedly introduced new pricing guidelines for pre-owned PS5 Pro consoles across its stores, effective October 16. Under the revised prices, the digital-only model can cost as much as $1,399.99 (approximately €1,204 / £1,036), while a unit equipped with a disc drive can reach $1,499.99 (approximately €1,290 / £1,110). These figures put used consoles well above the PS5 Pro's original retail price.
Sony launched the PS5 Pro in November 2024, several years after the original PS5 debuted amid chip shortages and widespread supply-chain disruptions. Those earlier problems had largely eased by January 2023, but the current situation presents a new challenge for buyers hoping to secure the upgraded hardware.
Console prices have also moved in the opposite direction from the discounts many players expected as the hardware aged. The original PS5 launched in November 2020 at $499 (€499 / £449) for the disc edition and $399 (€399 / £359) for the Digital Edition. By 2026, those prices had climbed to $649 (€649 / £569), and $599 (€599 / £519), respectively. Meanwhile, the PS5 Pro debuted at $699 (€799 / £699) in 2024, rose to $749 (€799 / £699) in August 2025, and reached $899 (€899 / £789) following another increase in April 2026 .
Although supply constraints can limit availability, GTA 6 may add further pressure as its release approaches. The game's launch on PlayStation and Xbox could encourage some players to purchase a PS5 Pro for its more capable hardware, particularly those who have yet to buy a current-generation console. Whether demand will ease after launch remains uncertain, but the reported shortage suggests that finding a PS5 Pro at a reasonable price could remain difficult for months.

articles.t: GTA 5 Leaves PS Plus Nov. 17, Two Days Before GTA 6
articles.chapeau: GTA 5 leaves the PS Plus Extra and Premium catalog on Nov. 17, two days before GTA 6 hits PS5. See what the PS5 notice says and which games join Oct. 20.
articles.txt:
Nov. 17, 2026, is the cutoff for Grand Theft Auto V in the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog, and its sequel, Grand Theft Auto VI , will launch on PS5 two days later, on Nov. 19. Access will end on that date for subscribers on both the Extra and Premium tiers.
PS5 owners learned of the cutoff through a system notification that asks, “why not take a trip to Los Santos in the meantime?” Two buttons appear side by side in the prompt, one to start GTA 5 and the other to pre-order GTA 6.
Counting from Oct. 19, subscribers have 29 days left with the included copy. Outside that prompt, the date has not appeared in any standalone Sony announcement.
GTA 5 is the first title confirmed to leave during November. Sony has yet to identify the remaining exits, which are expected to surface on Oct. 20 when the bulk of this month’s catalog additions arrive.
Rockstar Games’ two latest releases have rotated in and out of PS Plus Extra in short spells. Three separate stints for GTA 5 have come since December 2023, and Red Dead Redemption 2 is now in its third. No return date for GTA 5 has been announced, and Nov. 17 is the only date tied to its current run.
Adam Michel, senior director of content acquisition and operations at Sony Interactive Entertainment, outlined the next wave of catalog additions in the PlayStation Blog’s October roundup. Most of the lineup will become playable on Oct. 20, though a handful of titles carry different dates.
Mafia: The Old Country will arrive on PS5 as a third-person crime drama set among Sicily’s criminal underworld in the 1900s. Players control Enzo Favara, who fights to prove himself worthy of the Family.
A PlayStation Plus re-release label accompanies Horizon Forbidden West, which will return on PS5 and PS4. Aloy’s journey takes her into what Sony calls “a majestic but dangerous frontier that conceals mysterious new threats,” where bigger machines and unfamiliar tribes await.
Mycopunk is this month’s day-one entry and will join the catalog on PS5 at its Oct. 20 worldwide launch. Teams of as many as four players battle fungal aliens in the cooperative looter shooter, and its upgrade pool runs into the hundreds, each one crafted by hand.
Premium subscribers will also pick up Dino Crisis 2 and RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 Complete Edition. Seasonal Horrorfest offers for members will round out the month, and Sony’s post closes with the complete list.

Activision se moque de Zelda : les chiffres ne mentent pas, Call of Duty est le challenger de GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Pour l'éditeur américain, Call of Duty : Modern Warfare 4 s'imposera aux côtés de GTA 6 comme l'un des deux véritables mastodontes de l'industrie, reléguant le retour de Link au second plan. Face au rouleau compresseur 6 prévu pour la mi-novembre, la grande majorité des éditeurs...
articles.txt:
Pour l'éditeur américain, Call of Duty : Modern Warfare 4 s'imposera aux côtés de GTA 6 comme l'un des deux véritables mastodontes de l'industrie, reléguant le retour de Link au second plan.
Face au rouleau compresseur 6 prévu pour la mi-novembre, la grande majorité des éditeurs ont préféré battre en retraite et décaler leurs lancements. Nintendo, de son côté, maintient le cap en sortant le remake très attendu de son classique Zelda Ocarina Of Time sur Switch 2, à peine deux semaines avant ce raz-de-marée. C'est dans ce climat particulièrement tendu que les responsables de la franchise Call Of Duty ont décidé de s'inviter dans le face-à-face, revendiquant haut et fort leur place au sommet.
Le positionnement de la célèbre licence s'est précisé lors d'une récente prise de parole stratégique. Interrogé sur l'attention médiatique massive captée par le duel entre Rockstar et Nintendo, Tyler Bahl, le directeur marketing d'Activision, a tenu à recadrer les débats :
Sans vouloir offenser Zelda, je pense que GTA 6 et Modern Warfare 4 sont les deux plus grands jeux de l'année . Le fait que davantage de personnes retournent sur les interfaces de leur console, dépoussièrent leur Xbox ou leur PlayStation et recommencent à jouer, va générer une plus grande audience pour nous de manière globale.
La logique de l'exécutif repose sur un phénomène d'aspiration : l'effervescence générée par GTA 6 attirera un flux massif de joueurs inactifs, qui graviteront ensuite naturellement vers les expériences multijoueurs compétitives. L'ADN social du jeu d'action reste, d'après lui, son argument le plus persuasif grâce à la possibilité de se retrouver entre amis sur une multitude de supports, incluant désormais la Switch 2.
Si le discours officiel se veut d'une assurance inébranlable, les analystes du secteur observent une réalité statistique légèrement plus contrastée. Les données mesurant l'intention d'achat aux États-Unis au mois d'août dernier illustrent bien le rapport de force actuel. L'engouement pour le prochain Call Of Duty s'élevait à 15 % auprès des joueurs sur PC et consoles de salon, tandis que le retour de Link affichait un score de 10,4 %.
Cet écart numérique brut masque cependant une disparité fondamentale en matière de matériel disponible. Les consoles de la génération actuelle de Sony et Microsoft, associées au parc PC, constituent un vivier gigantesque approchant les 50 millions d'utilisateurs sur le seul territoire américain. À l'inverse, la base installée de la Switch 2 n'atteint pas encore le cap des 7 millions de foyers. Proportionnellement au nombre d'acheteurs potentiels équipés du support adéquat, le taux d'adoption anticipé pour Zelda Ocarina Of Time s'avère donc considérablement plus intense.
Derrière cette confiance affichée face à Zelda et GTA, Activision traverse une période assez compliquée pour sa série phare. Les chiffres indépendants montrent une baisse progressive du nombre de joueurs réguliers de Call of Duty au cours des deux dernières années, passant de 40 millions à environ 25 millions par mois. Sur le plan commercial, Call of Duty : Black Ops 7 n'a d'ailleurs atteint que la cinquième place des meilleures ventes américaines, une vraie déception pour un jeu historiquement habitué à la première marche du podium.
L'arrivée de Modern Warfare 4 sur la nouvelle console de Nintendo représente donc un vrai moteur de croissance pour Activision. Cette opération s'accompagne d'un partenariat important entre les deux entreprises, pensé pour arranger tout le monde. Tyler Bahl ajoute à propos de cette alliance :
Nintendo s'est investi à fond. Nous avons lancé une campagne de co-marketing avec eux . À bien des égards, ils cherchent à vieillir leur clientèle et à toucher un public plus large en proposant un jeu de Call Of Duty sur leur machine. Les ventes de leur console ont augmenté jusqu'à un certain point avant de stagner, et cela leur permettra d'élargir leur offre.
Ce partenariat historique marque un tournant pour les deux géants. En unissant leurs forces, Activision et Nintendo espèrent ainsi attirer de nouveaux publics pour s'imposer face à la déferlante GTA 6 en cette fin d'année 2026.

articles.t: Sounds Like GTA 6 Will Be Full of Details Like Red Dead's Infamous Horse Balls
articles.chapeau: A decade of silence, finally broken
articles.txt:
Fans have spent years gossiping about a crass detail in Red Dead Redemption 2 that has never been officially acknowledged by developer Rockstar Games. That silence, alongside unclear video footage, made some gamers doubt the detail was truly an intended part of the game. Now, nearly a decade later, Rockstar has confirmed the existence of RDR2 's "horse balls" — and given players a good reason to believe Grand Theft Auto 6 will be full of similar flourishes.
The news comes via a YouTube video from Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, who recently reported a major GTA 6 cover story for the outlet. The video is a summation of many notes that didn't make it into the final story, like an anecdote about how Rockstar spent years trying to redesign GTA 6 's weapon wheel. At one point, Rockstar got rid of the weapon wheel altogether. Yet despite countless iterations on the weapon loadout mechanic, Rockstar reverted to the original weapon wheel visible in GTA 6 footage.
The most surprising revelation, however, has to be about RDR2 's so-called horse balls. About nine years ago, footage of the open-world western went viral after fans noticed a strange animation. It seemed like Arthur Morgan's trusty steed had testicles with their own dedicated physics. Some swore that it looked like the stallion's privates would actually change shape depending on the weather.
Despite years of arguments, Rockstar never commented on the controversial feature. According to Schreier, the feature is real — but it was never a planned bullet point on Rockstar's production schedule. Instead, the animations made it into the final game because someone decided to spend time on it of their own accord. Schreier doesn't specify if the horse auteur was a single person or perhaps a group of people, but he did assert that RDR2 's long gestation period — and Rockstar parent company Take-Two's deep pockets — saw developers getting creative with what they put into the game.
"I think there are going to be a lot of details like that within this game," Schreier mused of GTA 6 while discussing RDR2 's horse balls.
GTA 6 isn't out yet, but Schreier's speculation is already well-substantiated. The open-world shooter is rife with minor details, like mud physics and complex NPC dialogue systems that showcase just how deep into the weeds Rockstar is willing to go. Whatever Rockstar did to craft its bespoke horse balls may well be getting an upgrade as well. Recent leaked footage showing co-protagonist Jason Duvall in the nude had viewers pointing out that the character's genitals had their own physics. We don't yet know if players will be able to move their members freely, but the game does feature a nudist colony where such physics would make perfect sense.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X on Nov. 19.

articles.t: GTA 6 weapon management: Rockstar did not want a traditional weapon wheel but had to settle
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is exactly a month away, and Rockstar has shown the game through extended gameplay footage as well as two trailers. The recent launch trailer was the latest addition, but a lot of details have surfaced through interviews, leaks, and more.
articles.txt:
A long time ago, when GTA 6 -related leaks started surfacing, and we’re talking about a year ago — the weapon wheel became a point of discussion. At the time, it was believed that Rockstar wanted a Red Dead Redemption 2 -style weapon wheel for GTA 6 , including a weapon wheel for the trunk of the car. Now we know that’s the direction Rockstar has gone with, but as it turns out, it was what they had to settle upon.
Journalist Jason Schreier recently released a massive story about the making of GTA 6 . While that included a lot of information, there were some details that didn’t make it into the final piece. One of those pieces of information had to do with the weapon wheel in GTA 6 . We’ve now seen what the weapon wheel looks like, and it became a point of contention among fans because of how “weird” it looked.
Schreier mentioned in his video that while the intention was to always have it be more grounded like Red Dead Redemption 2 (RDR 2), they originally wanted a completely different interface. Rockstar developers “spent months if not years” to develop a different weapon system, including trays, webs, and other options, but couldn’t find anything that worked as well. So, they decided to settle with using the weapon wheel.
Being grounded like RDR 2 means players will not be able to carry a massive arsenal of weapons on them. It has been revealed that players will be able to carry a pistol, two long-range weapons, and a melee weapon. They will also be able to use the trunk of cars to store more weapons.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' file size: Cyberleek reveals eye-watering storage requirements
articles.chapeau: Take it with a grain of salt, of course.
articles.txt:
The person leaking a bunch of gameplay videos of Grand Theft Auto VI may have just revealed the most useful information in all of their leaks.
On the Cyberleek website (per our colleagues at PCMag ), one of the latest updates included a threat to release a full build of the game in some form if people on the internet raised the leaker's crypto memecoin to a $30 million market cap. The coin has since crashed and looks like it's not going to get anywhere close to that level, but more importantly, the update included a file size for the playable build they have evidently been taking clips from: 200GB.
That's obviously a huge number, and makes up more than 20 percent of the usable storage space on a base PS5 or Xbox Series X console. Perhaps surprisingly, it's not as big as some other games, as recent Call of Duty titles clear 200GB by a good margin. But it would still be one of the biggest single-player file sizes we've seen yet, and speaks to the scale and scope of GTA 6 .
Of course, this should be taken with at least a tiny bit of skepticism. We don't know much about the build Cyberleek has been leaking footage from. If they do indeed have the full game on hand, it could be an older build that hasn't been fully optimized yet, so the true GTA 6 file size could theoretically be smaller once the actual game comes out on Nov. 19.

Les analyses techniques confirment un rendu natif en 1440p sans cette aide logicielle, jugée trop gourmande en ressources, tandis que le duo électro français Justice s'occupe d'une bande-son qui s'annonce déjà monumentale. Le célèbre studio américain a récemment dévoilé une séquence de 90 secondes de GTA 6, confirmant une sortie attendue pour le 19 novembre. Si la qualité visuelle globale impressionne par sa densité, l'analyse minutieuse des images capturées sur console révèle une approche technique très conservatrice. L'outil d'amélioration d'image par intelligence artificielle pourtant très vanté par Sony est totalement absent du flux vidéo. En parallèle de cette curiosité visuelle, la firme officialise une collaboration musicale d'envergure pour rythmer l'aventure de ses millions de futurs joueurs.
Les experts s'attendaient à voir la puissance logicielle qu QSR de Sony en action dès les premières secondes. Pourtant, le traitement d'image par QSSR (une technique d'upscaling propulsée par intelligence artificielle) brille par son absence. Sur la PS5 , ce silence technologique intrigue d'autant plus que le constructeur vante activement les mérites de cette fonctionnalité à tout va. Il semble que la gourmandise de cet algorithme refroidisse pourtant certains studios tiers.
Avec un objectif d'affichage fixé en 1440p natif, le moteur graphique monopolise déjà l'essentiel des capacités de calcul. Intégrer cet outil complexe coûterait environ 4 millisecondes sur un budget total de 33 ms, ce qui représente un sacrifice bien trop lourd pour un bénéfice marginal à l'écran. Les équipes de conception ont préféré allouer ces précieuses ressources à la physique du jeu et aux détails des décors. Il faut dire que GTA 6 s'annonce comme un monde ouvert qui fourmille de détails, il faut donc chercher l'optimisation au maximum.
Les précédentes vidéos promotionnelles avaient laissé les puristes sur leur faim avec d'étranges saccades dans les déplacements. Un rythme d'animation parfois hasardeux entachait la perception globale de l'œuvre. Sur ce nouveau montage de Grand Theft Auto VI , ces défauts du moteur interne semblent enfin appartenir au passé. Les mouvements respirent avec beaucoup plus de naturel.
Let's analyze tonemapping in GTA 6! Launch trailer is SDR but still gives us insight into how they are working with colors. Overall, what I see looks nice. Nothing appears particularly broken with one big exception. Gradients are smooth. Skin tones are great. Hue paths/shifts… pic.twitter.com/Kzlhd3agfO
La fluidité des déplacements des foules est désormais irréprochable. Même lors des lents panoramiques d'ambiance ou des scènes d'action frénétiques , le rendu global reste parfaitement cohérent. L'attente prolongée valait visiblement le coup pour peaufiner l'optimisation visuelle . C'est un soulagement majeur pour les joueurs qui redoutaient de retrouver les vieilles tares techniques des précédents épisodes.
La dimension sonore de cette aventure n'a pas été reléguée au second plan, bien au contraire. Le groupe électro emblématique Justice prend officiellement la direction de la partition originale. Leur premier extrait dévoilé, fusionnant les talents d'artistes internationaux prestigieux, garantit une ambiance urbaine électrique .
Le panorama musical s'annonce d'une richesse intense avec au total 34 morceaux exclusifs intégrés à la tracklist de lancement. Entre stations de radio virtuelles finement curatées et compositions instrumentales, le travail d'habillage sonore s'annonce pharaonique.
Les analyses techniques de la vidéo pointent vers une résolution de base en 1440p. L'image est ensuite étirée vers la 4K sans utiliser les derniers algorithmes de mise à l'échelle par intelligence artificielle de la console.
Le lancement mondial de l'aventure est programmé pour le 19 novembre sur les plateformes de salon actuelles, marquant le point culminant d'une attente longue de plus d'une décennie.

articles.txt:
Ajouter aux sources préférées Grand Theft Auto VI s'annonce comme une véritable révolution pour les mondes ouverts, à tous les niveaux. Alors que la sortie du jeu approche à grands pas sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series, de nouvelles informations viennent confirmer l'ambition démesurée de Rockstar Games. La carte, estimée à environ trois fois la taille de celle de Red Dead Redemption 2 , ne se contentera pas d'offrir de vastes étendues vides. La densité urbaine et l'interactivité seront au cœur de l'expérience, redéfinissant les standards du studio .
L'immensité du monde de Grand Theft Auto 6 ne se mesurera pas uniquement en kilomètres carrés, mais bien en profondeur d'exploration . Aaron Garbut, co-directeur du studio, a récemment souligné l'attention maniaque portée aux détails dans chaque pièce façonnée à la main. Les développeurs ont pensé à tout, de la place qu'occupent les personnages à ce qu'ils boivent, en passant par les traces laissées sur les tables . Cette minutie soulève naturellement une question cruciale concernant le nombre de bâtiments qu'il sera possible de visiter.
Si aucun chiffre précis n'a été officiellement arrêté par le studio, plusieurs cadres de Rockstar, dont Jennifer Kolbe, Aaron Garbut, Phil Hooker et Rob Nelson, ont confié au journaliste Jason Schreier de Bloomberg qu'il y aura des centaines d'intérieurs à explorer . Ce niveau de détail a été illustré par un exemple concret de gameplay, où le joueur peut s'introduire discrètement dans une station-service et dérober la caisse sans éveiller les soupçons.
Outre la complexité du monde ouvert, la narration semble elle aussi prendre un tournant différent. Jason Schreier précise que le scénario de ce nouvel opus puise davantage ses inspirations dans Red Dead Redemption 2 que dans Grand Theft Auto V . Concrètement, l'histoire se concentre sur deux protagonistes qui apprécient réellement passer du temps ensemble. Le journaliste a d'ailleurs contrasté la première heure de jeu avec celle de son prédécesseur, soulignant que le nihilisme amer de l'épisode précédent devenait rapidement épuisant .
Cette nouvelle approche promet une dynamique beaucoup plus nuancée et humaine entre Lucia et Jason. Bien entendu, le ton satirique propre à la franchise devrait resurgir plus tard dans l'aventure, mais la fondation narrative s'annonce nettement plus ancrée dans la relation entre les deux personnages principaux .
GTA 6 promet une satire de la société encore plus provocatrice
La campagne promotionnelle de Grand Theft Auto 6 s'accélère avec de nouvelles révélations. Rockstar Games promet une satire sociale encore plus mordante et démesurée que…
La manière dont les joueurs interagiront avec Lucia et Jason aura un impact direct sur la direction que prendra leur relation, ce qui influencera inévitablement le déroulement de l'histoire. Cette mécanique de choix et de conséquences, bien que ses contours exacts restent à définir, témoigne de la volonté de Rockstar de proposer une expérience plus organique et personnalisée .
Avec un lancement prévu dans un mois, les joueurs n'auront plus à patienter très longtemps pour découvrir par eux-mêmes GTA 6, qui s'annonce déjà comme un succès, tant il est attendu.

Le compte Instagram officiel du Goodyear Blimp a publié un message faisant référence à Vice City, la célèbre ville fictive de l’univers Grand Theft Auto. Avec la mention Vice City, Leonida, USA, accompagnée des emojis plage et crocodile ainsi que du hashtag GTA 6, cette publication joue directement avec l’univers du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games.
La publication a été partagée sur le compte vérifié @goodyearblimp, consacré au célèbre dirigeable publicitaire Goodyear. Son message est volontairement concis : une localisation fictive, Vice City, associée à Leonida, l’État dans lequel se déroule GTA 6, et une référence explicite au jeu.
Le clin d’œil est particulièrement parlant pour les fans de la franchise. Vice City constitue l’un des lieux emblématiques de Grand Theft Auto et revient au premier plan dans le prochain épisode de Rockstar Games. L’association avec Leonida reprend directement les noms utilisés pour présenter l’environnement de GTA 6.
Avec GTA 6, Rockstar Games emmène les joueurs dans l’État fictif de Leonida, qui accueille notamment Vice City. Cette dernière s’inspire de Miami et de la Floride, avec un univers marqué par les paysages côtiers, les zones urbaines et les marécages.
Les crocodiles et l’ambiance balnéaire évoqués dans la publication de Goodyear font ainsi écho à l’imagerie associée à cette région. Le message adopte les codes visuels et géographiques de GTA 6 pour proposer un clin d’œil immédiatement reconnaissable par la communauté.
En associant le nom de Vice City à celui de Leonida, le compte officiel du Goodyear Blimp s’inscrit dans la vague de références à l’univers du prochain Grand Theft Auto. Une publication courte, mais suffisamment explicite pour attirer l’attention des fans et rappeler l’attente qui entoure le jeu.
Reste à savoir si ce clin d’œil se limitera aux réseaux sociaux ou s’il s’inscrit dans une initiative plus large.

articles.txt:
La version PC de Grand Theft Auto VI pourrait sortir bien plus rapidement que prévu. Selon un article de GamesBeat , Rockstar Games viserait le premier trimestre 2027 pour porter son prochain blockbuster sur ordinateur, soit quelques mois seulement après sa sortie sur consoles. Une information qui reste toutefois à prendre avec précaution : le studio n’a confirmé ni l’existence d’une version PC ni son calendrier de lancement.
Le rapport s’appuie sur quatre sources anonymes issues de l’industrie, présentées comme familières des plans de Rockstar. Si cette fenêtre se confirmait, l’écart entre les versions console et PC serait particulièrement réduit. GTA 6 est actuellement annoncé pour le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S, selon le site officiel de Rockstar. Une sortie PC avant la fin mars 2027 représenterait donc un délai d’environ quatre mois.
Ce scénario romprait avec les habitudes du studio. GTA 5 avait attendu près de dix-neuf mois avant d’arriver sur PC, tandis que Red Dead Redemption 2 avait nécessité environ un an. Rockstar privilégie traditionnellement les consoles lors du lancement de ses productions majeures, avant de proposer une version PC retravaillée, souvent accompagnée d’améliorations techniques.
Plusieurs facteurs pourraient néanmoins encourager une sortie plus rapide. Le marché PC occupe une place croissante dans l’industrie, et réduire le délai permettrait à Rockstar de profiter plus tôt d’une audience supplémentaire. Mais cette stratégie reste hypothétique : aucune annonce officielle ne vient étayer le calendrier rapporté par GamesBeat.
En attendant, les joueurs PC devront donc patienter sans date confirmée. Si cette rumeur se vérifie, GTA 6 pourrait toutefois faire exception à une tradition bien installée chez Rockstar. Pour l’heure, mieux vaut considérer le premier trimestre 2027 comme une possibilité, et non comme une échéance acquise.

articles.t: 13 Years Ago, Rockstar Suffered a Leak Worse Than GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Before unauthorized clips of GTA 6 scandalized fans, GTA 5 made video game leak history for Rockstar and Sony
articles.txt:
What could possibly be worse than footage of the world's most anticipated video game leaking onto the internet early , in an unfinished state? Easy. A game with a similar cultural footprint becoming playable ahead of its release. It seems unthinkable now in the age of Denuvo, but this exact nightmare scenario happened for Rockstar ahead of the release of Grand Theft Auto 5 .
The leaks began a few weeks before GTA 5 's official launch, after a snafu with the PlayStation Store allowed players with pre-orders to access some of the game's files. At first, the leaks didn't seem like such a big deal. The files told fans how much space the game would take up on their PS3 hard drives, and listed specific songs from the game's soundtrack. Another leak stemming from early strategy guides also showed players the game's map sooner than intended.
To be sure, the leaks didn't make anyone working on the game happy. A blog post from Rockstar said , “As you can imagine, we are deeply disappointed by leaks and spoilers being spread in advance of the game's launch. GTA V represents years of hard work by many people across the world, and we all couldn't be more excited to finally share it with you properly this September 17th.”
Sony, for its part, subsequently pulled the preload and apologized profusely to fans and Rockstar for the gaffe. Compared to the GTA 6 leaks, where players were able to see the main characters naked, this data breach sounds quaint. It's less common these days, but there are plenty of modern examples of major games being pirated early. Heck, nearly every big Nintendo game of the last generation was pirated well ahead of launch.
Back in 2013, however, digital games had just entered the mainstream — and leaks of this magnitude weren't a regular occurrence. The situation worsened quickly after players began sharing information about the game's story and ending. Rockstar and Sony alike had to warn players that they could be banned for spoiling the game early. While we've seen glimpses of GTA 6 's story and have some educated guesses about its ending , Rockstar has managed to keep such details under wraps so far.
Image: Rockstar Games None of these events were nearly as significant as what came after: the game was uploaded to torrent websites. This leak subsequently allowed people with jailbroken consoles to play the game early without paying for it. Can you imagine the chaos that would unfold if the same happened in GTA 6 ? A leaker merely threatening to release GTA 6 early has been called a "doomsday scenario."
The circumstances are wildly different, of course. The game that leaked in 2013 was, as far as anyone could tell, the finished experience — and it was pirated somewhat close to launch. The GTA 6 that's ostensibly being held hostage by Cyberleek may be an old build with accompanying dev tools. Rockstar doesn't plan on releasing GTA 6 on a physical disc , and it's unclear if the PC version will only be streamable. The consequences of a GTA 6 leak where players could poke at the game's files and see how the sausage was made are hard to predict.
A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.
Phones and cameras also weren't nearly as good as they are now, so many of the leaks were shared in tiny, grainy pictures that were sometimes hard to make out.
"I don't know how 240p video even exists," one NeoGAF user complained .
Half of these leaks occurred on Vine, which doesn't even exist anymore. Meanwhile, GTA 6 's leaks show the protagonists fully nude in 4K .
Lucia Caminos using a punching bag in Grand Theft Auto 6 Rockstar Games/Take Two Interactive Some things are true in 2026 as they were in 2013, though. Years before they marveled at digital mud , fans couldn't believe how realistic GTA 5 looked.
"This could almost be a real live video footage," one Redditor remarked .
Most of all, nearly everyone hated watching the way other people played GTA. Either leakers are cursed to be bad video game players ... or no one is as good at GTA as they think.
"The dude was driving like an idiot," another NeoGAF user wrote .

articles.t: Cyberleek Threatens GTA 6 Build Leak Over Discs And An Apology
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek says a GTA 6 build leak will happen at a 30M market cap unless Take-Two ships physical discs and apologises. We look at what’s actually known.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 has spent years being picked apart by leakers, and now one of them is threatening to go much further than just sharing footage. Cyberleek has said on his website that he’ll release a playable build of the game to the public once he hits 30 million in market cap, as spotted in a post on r/GamingLeaksAndRumours . This GTA 6 build leak threat comes with conditions attached, and TakeTwo is the one being asked to meet them.
It is worth noting that none of this has been verified and there’s no confirmation that Cyberleek actually has a build, and neither Rockstar nor TakeTwo has responded publicly.
Cyberleek also acknowledged that the publisher probably assumes he’s bluffing and that’s a fair assumption on TakeTwo’s part, given that he hasn’t shown anything publicly that proves he has a build to release.
The market cap part is the strangest element. Market capitalisation usually refers to the total value of a company’s shares or a cryptocurrency token, but the post doesn’t say what asset this figure applies to, what currency it’s measured in or who controls it. Without that, it’s impossible to tell how close he is to the target, or whether the whole thing’s tied to some kind of token promotion.
The physical disc condition suggests Cyberleek is positioning himself as speaking for players rather than simply holding a game to ransom. The post doesn’t explain the reasoning, though, or what TakeTwo has done that he thinks warrants an apology.
Disc ownership has been a sore point across the industry for a while. More big releases are shipping as download codes or with only part of the game on the disc, and plenty of players see a physical copy as the only version they truly own. Whether that’s what’s driving this demand isn’t clear from what’s been shared.
If Cyberleek is bluffing, he’s picked a target where leaks are easy to believe. Rockstar’s history includes the 2022 breach that put early GTA 6 development footage online, and the hacker behind that is set to go back to court just days before the game launches . Older material keeps surfacing too, with stolen GTA 5 files revealing cancelled single-player expansions .
There’s a big difference between leaking video and leaking a working build, though. Footage spoils surprises. A build in the wild could be datamined for every mission, map area and system Rockstar’s spent years developing, and it’d give cheat makers a head start before the game even goes on sale.
For anyone on PC hoping a leak means getting hands on GTA 6 early, it’s worth being sceptical. Supposed leaked builds of huge games are a common lure for malware, because people are willing to download large archives from unknown sources and run whatever’s inside.
Even if a genuine build did appear, there’s no indication of what platform it’d be for or how complete it’d be. Development builds are often unstable, unoptimised and tied to specific hardware or tools, so it’s far from guaranteed anyone could run one on a normal gaming PC.
If something does surface claiming to be GTA 6, the safest move is to leave it alone. A compromised system isn’t a fair trade for an early look at a game that’s coming anyway. For now, this looks more like an attention grab than a credible threat, especially with that unexplained market cap target attached.
Do you think Cyberleek actually has a build, or is this a bluff aimed at hype? Let’s know your thoughts in the comments.

articles.chapeau: Une affiche repérée dans un magasin GameStop affirme que les versions physiques de GTA 6 incluront une carte collector. Rien d’officiel pour l’instant.
articles.txt:
Une affiche repérée dans un magasin GameStop affirme que les versions physiques de GTA 6 incluront une carte collector. Rien d’officiel pour l’instant.
Le plus important, là, c’est simple. Une nouvelle fuite autour de GTA 6 affirme qu’une carte collector physique serait glissée dans chaque copie physique du jeu. Sauf qu’on ne l’a pas vue, et personne n’a encore validé ça noir sur blanc.
Ce qui circule en ligne ne montre pas la carte elle-même. Juste son existence supposée. L’idée, c’est que les éditions physiques de GTA 6 incluraient une carte collector, ce qui parle forcément aux joueurs qui aiment les bonus tangibles, ceux qu’on garde après avoir refermé la boîte.
Mais il y a un vrai trou dans l’histoire. On ne sait pas à quoi ressemble cette carte, ni ce qu’elle contient exactement. Pas de visuel, pas de détail, pas de confirmation. Résultat ? Pour l’instant, c’est une info qui excite pas mal de monde, mais qui reste très incomplète.
L’origine de la fuite est assez précise. Un post apparu sur le Reddit consacré à GTA 6 montre ce qui ressemble à une publicité bricolée, affichée sur la vitrine d’un magasin GameStop . Le lieu exact du magasin n’a pas été révélé.
Ensuite, la machine s’est emballée. Le post a été repris par des comptes bien connus de la sphère Grand Theft Auto sur X et ailleurs, ce qui a suffi à faire remonter l’info très vite.
Le détail qui change un peu la donne, c’est que la personne ayant partagé le post dit être entrée dans le magasin et avoir parlé aux employés. D’après elle, ils auraient répété la même information. C’est intéressant, clairement. Ce n’est toujours pas une preuve définitive.
Ni GameStop ni qui que ce soit d’officiel n’a communiqué là-dessus. Et ça, ça pèse lourd. L’information aurait seulement fait surface dans certains magasins, pas via une annonce large et carrée.
Bon, on a donc une fuite plausible, un support physique aperçu en boutique, et un relais massif sur les réseaux. Mais on n’a pas la pièce maîtresse, une confirmation officielle. Tant qu’elle n’arrive pas, cette histoire de carte collector reste un bonus possible, pas une promesse gravée dans le marbre.
Pour les fans de GTA 6 , ça suffit à surveiller le dossier de près. Pas à précommander les yeux fermés.

articles.txt:
GTA 6 fans spot mysterious detail at 0:55 in new trailer Anand Sinha Fri, October 16, 2026 at 3:04 PM CDT 4 min read On Oct. 15, Rockstar Games published the much-anticipated launch trailer for the Grand Theft Auto VI . The game, which has been in production for than 8 years, finally gave fans a glimpse of what to expect.
The thrilling trailer has already generated more than 26.3 million views on YouTube. But there is one mysterious detail that has caught the attention of fans on X, Reddit, and Instagram.
With an estimated budget of $1 billion-$2 billion , the GTA 6 has taken more than a decade to make and can be counted among the most enduring pop culture phenomena. The game is scheduled to launch on Nov. 19.
The 90-second trailer follows the game's protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, driving around the streets of the fictional U.S. state of Leonida. The couple are seen flirting, romancing, and having a lot of fun while getting chased down by law enforcement agencies.
Around 00:55 seconds, the GTA 6 trailer features the logo of Dacity Coin pasted on the side of an aircraft.
When a Reddit user posted a screenshot from the trailer showing the coin on the GTAVI sub, fans shared some wild theories.
The original poster Odd_West5719 wondered if the game would feature a cryptocurrency .
In simple words, a cryptocurrency is a digital currency that relies on cryptography to secure transactions and is created on a distributed online ledger called blockchain .
A distributed ledger means no central body creates or controls the financial records; it's only after multiple contributors (nodes) spread across the world reach a consensus that a transaction is confirmed.
When the first cryptocurrency, Bitcoin (BTC), was launched in 2009, it was mocked for its purported ambition to take on Wall Street.
Memes mocking the early enthusiasm for crypto birthed meme coins — a type of cryptocurrency that was built on the same blockchain technology but never pretended to have any utility except mocking cryptocurrencies.
Today, Bitcoin's market cap is worth $1.65 trillion. If BTC were a company, it would be ranked among the world's top 10 companies.
Some of the meme coins like Dogecoin (DOGE) have also become extremely popular, thanks to support from tycoons like Elon Musk .

Responding to the Reddit post, one user commented that the game will mock "crypto bros" and another wondered about the game possibly having a storyline around a rug pull — a kind of scam.
GTA Wiki, the X page of the fan-based platform that shares detailed information on the game's trivia, claimed Dacity Coin is a cryptocurrency in the game that gets promoted through publicity stunts.
"I think that's Jason and Lucia doing a side hustle," a fan quipped.
An Instagram handle called Page Z also wondered if the fictional cryptocurrency potentially hints at scams within the game.
GTA Wiki, the fan-based database, describes Dacity Coin as a fictional cryptocurrency created by AudaCity, a brand due to appear in the upcoming game.
As per GTA Wiki, Dacity Coin was first mentioned in the Oct. 11 leak which showed Lucia being asked to advertise AudaCity through a parachuting stunt in Vice City to raise money for the coin.
As reported earlier , an individual or a group called CyberLeek has been leaking GTA 6's original footage for months now and collecting money through an eponymous meme coin.
The coin has faced scam accusations , which CyberLeek has sought to deny by burning coins .
The whole controversy only shows the prevalence of crypto scams.
As per the onchain analytics platform TRM Labs , illicit crypto volume hit a record $158 billion in 2025, up nearly 145% from 2024. However, illicit volume as a proportion of overall volume fell from 1.3% in 2024 to 1.2% in 2025.

articles.t: GTA 6 is eyeing Lucia as the next Arthur Morgan; here's why
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games believes the new GTA heroine will 'stand tall' as the greatest gaming character ever created!
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games believes the new GTA heroine will 'stand tall' as the greatest gaming character they've ever created.
Taking over the mantle from Trevor, Franklin and Michael, the power duo of Lucia and Jason are quickly being examined by every Grand Theft Auto fan, as the Bonnie and Clyde protagonists hold the key to GTA 6 being the greatest game of all time.
Already, the two lead characters are kicking up a fuss, as the motivations behind their actions are being subjected to wild theories .
But Rockstar is going all in on framing the duo as a powerhouse team, as seen in the launch trailer , which was released on October 15.
In a frantic 90-second, action-heavy clip, the trailer consistently showcased Lucia's standalone personality, split only by steamy shower scenes that confirmed that the nude gameplay leaks were true.
With the new heroine set to take control of the GTA 6 narrative, Lucia is now being tipped to be the outright main character, and Rockstar is already putting her on a podium of the highest expectations.
Having championed a number of protagonists in a portfolio of colossal games, Rockstar Games has revealed that Lucia is their number one choice to be the face of the studio for the next generation, taking over from Arthur Morgan.
Of course, that's high praise, as Morgan is widely considered to be one of the best characters ever made, possibly the single greatest video game protagonist outside the likes of Nintendo's Mario.
At the very least, Morgan is regarded as the best of Rockstar Games, and that bar is set to be raised by Lucia,
Speaking in an interview with LOVE Magazine , Rockstar Games writer Alexa D'Agostino claimed that Lucia is the main driving force behind a lot of the decisions made in the storyline, often being overly naive, fearless and ambitious.
"Lucia had to be someone who wanted a better life for herself, and wouldn’t let the obstacles in the way of that life stop her getting it," she said.
"There are many badass women like her, just as there are many men like Jason. We just focused on capturing that.
"When you are focusing on writing a fully realized person with their own wants, you’re getting to get something perfectly imperfect, with clichés, but also undeniably real. That’s how you get a woman that can stand tall next to the likes of Arthur Morgan and Niko Bellic."
Read Next: GTA 6 leaker threatens to drop entire game as 6 new features confirmed in Lucia gameplay
Even the inclusion of Niko Bellic is an extremely high bar, as the Grand Theft Auto IV legend is often hailed as the pinnacle of the franchise, having been awarded a bigger role than the GTA V trio who shared responsibilities.
If we're projecting expectations, even matching John Marston from the original Red Dead Redemption would be enough for Lucia to spearhead GTA 6 to its perch as the greatest game of all time, leaving Jason to tip it over the edge.
The worry is that Jason's personality is rather bland, though, following his partner in crime at every turn, rather than having his own leads - that is, unless the popular dual-personality theory comes true...
Still, Lucia is the queen we'll be following moving forward, and if she's anything like what Rockstar is claiming, we're in for a huge treat.

Some players are sure that the developers left a "signal" for the hacker.
Until recently, a hacker (or group) under the nickname Cyberleek actively published Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage online and also threatened to leak a build with the full story. However, he then reconsidered his decision and abandoned further leaks.
Soon after, Rockstar Games released the Grand Theft Auto VI trailer. Fans began to examine the footage, and a moment with a green car attracted attention. Those who closely followed the leaks immediately recognized it — it appeared in Cyberleek's videos.
1 / 2 Image source: Rockstar Games In the trailer, this model can be seen at the 0:46 mark — the driver is trying to escape from the police. Players believe that the appearance of this car is not a random coincidence. It is assumed that in this way, the developers from Rockstar Games sent a warning signal to Cyberleek to prevent further possible leaks.
Discussion participants recalled how in one of the Grand Theft Auto VI trailers, the opening scene with Jason began with him saying he was fixing some leaks (in the Russian subtitles, the phrase “fixing some leaks” was translated as “just fixing the roof,” so some Russian-speaking players might have missed the reference). During that period, hackers were leaking internal studio materials.
